{{av}}

Create entire sets of furniture in this workshop. This will greatly simplify outfitting rooms. You can choose stone, bone, silver, gold or wood as materials. If you stockpile-link it, it is very easy to color code your fortress.

The following sets are possible:

* Bedroom Set: 1 [[cv:bed|Bed]], 1 [[cv:container|Box]], 1 [[cv:door|Door,]] 1 [[cv:cabinet|Cabinet]].

* Noble Bedroom Set: 1 Bed, 2 Boxes, 1 Door, 1 [[cv:cabinet|Cabinet]], 1 [[cv:weapon rack|Weapon rack]], 1 [[cv:armor stand|Armor stand]].

* Diningroom Set: 4 [[cv:table|Tables]], 4 [[cv:throne|Chairs]].

* Office Set: 1 Table, 1 Chair, 1 Door.

* Graveyard Set: 4 [[cv:coffin|Coffins]], 1 Door.

* Storage Set: 3 [[cv:bin|bins]], 3 [[cv:barrel|barrels]].
